name: gemini-subagent
description: Managed Antigravity and optional Gemini CLI workers. Native Windows adaptation prerelease; Windows acceptance pending.

interface.shortDescription: Run controlled Google CLI workers from Codex
interface.longDescription: Delegate work to official Antigravity or optional Gemini CLI workers with managed lifecycle and durable results. Version 0.4.0-alpha.1 adds experimental native Windows support alongside macOS. Windows 11 23H2 offline and Codex-controlled read/resume evidence exists; project writes failed, real timeout was not triggered, and first-time official login is unproven. Windows 24H2+ release acceptance is pending. Windows multi-account switching and shared reads remain disabled.
defaultPrompt: Show Gemini worker, quota, account, or session status with $gemini-subagent:status
Retrieve the latest managed Gemini result with $gemini-subagent:result
